digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — necessity probe + bug review tier
propositions: FixedBench shows 35-65% over-action rate with no plan-review criterion to gate unnecessary changes; a necessity probe must flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing need.

Bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with zero substantive review (verified: bug 5886 REVIEW_RESULT={runner:exempt,verdict:PASS,llm_calls:0}); piece (b) routes bugs through DET floor + necessity probe as advisory tier.
The necessity advisory criterion (1-TURN, pass-1, facet=scope-intent, never suppresses bug) must register in criteria_routing.json and CANONICAL_LLM to avoid orphan validation failure.

Bounded sanity fixtures (5 single-criterion live runs, not E2 batch) must demonstrate necessity fires on over-action positives, is clean on well-motivated negatives, and bug 5886 receives light advisory review instead of exempt-PASS.

Both criteria ship advisory (never block); promotion to blocking is dogfood-gated on standing recorder per-criterion effectiveness metrics (high detection_proxy, low blocking_fp_proxy) as recorded on merged Gerrit change #811.
